name: StarRupture
tagline: Native connector for StarRupture dedicated servers: one ModLoader plugin inside the server that connects to Takaro itself, no sidecar.
requirements: StarRupture Windows dedicated server (Steam app 3809400) build named in the release
File access to the server's StarRupture\Binaries\Win64 folder

assets.label: Server plugin (ModLoader included)
assets.hint: Stop the server, unzip into StarRupture\Binaries\Win64 (next to StarRuptureServerEOS-Win64-Shipping.exe), copy ModLoader\Plugins\config\TakaroStarRupture.example.ini to TakaroStarRupture.ini, paste the registration token and start the server.
